text.en: My main responsibility this week is finishing the client review before we start the next phase.

data.title: Present perfect for unresolved situations
data.rule_summary: Use the present perfect for actions or situations connected to now, especially previous attempts, progress, and recent changes.

explanation.fa: برای کارها یا وضعیت‌هایی که به حال مربوط‌اند، مخصوصاً تلاش‌های قبلی و تغییرات اخیر، از present perfect استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.fa: دو بار با پشتیبانی تماس گرفته‌ام.

examples.en: The problem has become more frequent.

data.title: Degrees of obligation
data.rule_summary: Use must and have to for strong obligation, should for advice, and don't have to for lack of necessity.

explanation.fa: برای اجبار قوی از must/have to، برای توصیه از should و برای نبود ضرورت از don't have to استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.en: I have to finish this today.
You don't have to attend in person.

data.title: Deadline and progress language
data.rule_summary: Use by, within, on track, behind schedule, and due to describe timing and progress precisely.

explanation.fa: برای زمان‌بندی و پیشرفت از by، within، on track، behind schedule و due استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.en: We're on track to finish by Thursday.
examples.fa: طبق برنامه تا پنجشنبه تمام می‌کنیم.

examples.en: The report is due at noon.
